empires.name: The Mongol Khanates
empires.note: Rolling steppe with nothing on it to burn. No fixed villages - the camps pack and move before you find them, and the riders shoot backwards at a gallop.
empires.throne: Karakorum - a camp, not a city

empires.name: The Principalities of Rus
empires.note: Winter does half their fighting for them - it starves an army standing still. Shield walls across the forest tracks, and wooden kremlins that burn very well once you get to them.

places.name: Kiev
places.note: The high seat above the Dnieper - stone gates, deep ditch, and a dozen princes already quarrelling over who sits in it.

places.name: Novgorod
places.note: Fur and wax stacked in the warehouses, marsh on every road in - come before the thaw or not at all.

places.name: Vladimir
places.note: White stone churches, new walls, and the treasury that used to be Kiev's.

places.name: Chernigov
places.note: A day's ride from the throne and sour about it; earth ramparts, and horsemen who know the steppe road.

places.name: Smolensk
places.note: Every boat on the upper Dnieper is dragged overland here. The tolls are heavy and so is the garrison.

places.name: Pskov
places.note: Stone walls on the Velikaya; the men there have already fought somebody this year.

places.name: Polotsk
places.note: Sits astride the Dvina portage, keeps its own prince, and sends Kiev nothing.

places.name: Ladoga
places.note: Timber fort at the river mouth, first stop on the northern trade - the silver is under the floorboards.

places.name: Beloozero
places.note: Fishing huts where the lake drains out, four weeks of forest from anywhere; the tribute comes in pelts.
